caption: The video captures a calm, slow-moving stream bordered on both banks by dense, bright-green summer foliage beneath a pale sky. The water fills the lower half of the frame, mirroring the trees and clouds in a soft, elongated reflection. A small rock protrudes from the left bank near mid-frame while a fallen log rests along the right bank, both remaining fixed. A diagonal lens-flare streak with green and orange circular artifacts overlays the upper-left and left portions of the image, staying constant in position. The dominant visible process is the gentle, continuous shimmer of the water surface, where the reflected shapes of leaves and sky waver and distort without translating or dramatically deforming. Tiny pale flecks drift negligibly near the lower-center of the water, holding roughly the same positions from frame to frame. The framing holds steady with no detectable pan, tilt, or zoom, and the visible elements remain the same throughout. The quiet ripple pattern persists steadily across the excerpt, with no obvious larger motion emerging.
